entries.full_claim: The piecewise envelope E_C on covered C and M on unresolved U is valid and pointwise sharp over exactly the declared bounded-envelope information class.
entries.domain: One bounded R168 effect, one valid covered envelope and one explicit C/U partition.
entries.proof_or_source: Note §4; case split and extremal witness; 323,847 exact pointwise checks.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Sharpness is not a consumer-kernel realizability theorem.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Ancestor/formation keeps a rare new branch in U rather than treating it as absent.

entries.full_claim: Any nonempty unresolved remainder without an added pointwise bridge preserves M as the sharp global supremum bound, regardless of remainder mass.
entries.domain: Every nonempty U under the inherited cap M.
entries.proof_or_source: Note §§4,6; set e=M at one point of U; 1,001 finite witnesses.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: An empty U or a separate pointwise certificate can yield a lower bound.
entries.thought_experiment_role: A rare extreme human/device configuration can have tiny mass and maximal amplitude.

entries.full_claim: For fixed mu, integral e is bounded by integral_C E_C plus M mu(U), sharply over the information class; E_C<=b and mu(U)<=epsilon imply b+(M-b)epsilon.
entries.domain: One independently justified target probability measure and simultaneous covered/remainder bounds.
entries.proof_or_source: Note §5; integrate the piecewise envelope; 66,429 exact integral checks.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: A convenience or dependent measure does not discharge the premise; mean control does not bound the supremum.
entries.thought_experiment_role: A finite calculator address distribution can weight undocumented states without erasing them.

entries.full_claim: For tau<M, exceedance mass is bounded by covered-envelope exceedance mass plus remainder mass.
entries.domain: One fixed tau, target measure, C/U partition and compatible effect.
all_premises: all other points lie in U
entries.proof_or_source: Note §5; set inclusion; 132,858 exact exceedance checks.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: The bound permits effect M throughout U and does not imply amplitude control.
entries.thought_experiment_role: A copied interface can retain small hidden-state mass while those states remain high effect.

entries.full_claim: A universal actual route/channel radius from every admitted cell context to an R169 anchor transports the anchor envelope by at most twice that radius.
entries.domain: One physically bounded cell, matching actual anchor and frozen consumer geometry.
entries.proof_or_source: Note §3; direct application of R169's effect modulus.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Endpoints or fitted interpolation do not prove the universal within-cell premise.
entries.thought_experiment_role: A verified address decoder can cover calculator states without reconstructing the whole device.

entries.full_claim: A valid held-out target context that violates frozen admission/route/budget clauses refutes the cell certificate; valid excess remainder mass refutes its epsilon certificate.
entries.domain: One frozen target/cell/mass plan and independent boundary challenges.
entries.proof_or_source: Note §7; violation of a universal or simultaneous upper clause falsifies the conjunction.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Passing finite challenges does not prove unbounded-domain completeness; invalid challenges prove nothing.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Swap/copy cases challenge actual hidden-state admission rather than interface similarity.

entries.full_claim: The complete R166-R169 package plus valid R170 triage licenses only the exact closed-amplitude or open-mass conclusion on one common episode.
entries.domain: One common actual P/I/K/D/rho, target and certificate package.
entries.proof_or_source: Note §§8,11 and the explicit all-of application rule.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: No actual target inventory, neural completeness, C1 derivation, B_min, basal gate or unique owner.
entries.thought_experiment_role: All four families audit open-world actuality and the exact strength of each conclusion.
